title: Adapter operation: execute v1
description: 00 §10 protocol operation 'execute' (04.7.1-T1.2). Direction: adapter → server — the per-attempt events a locked-manifest execution produced (source §4: 'events per attempt; deadline and cancel token'). Every entry is the shared 00 §9.4 event envelope, referenced by $id (urn:evidgate:contract:event-envelope.v1) and never copied: removing or renaming an envelope member changes this schema's verdicts without editing this file. At most 500 events, like the ingest batch (00 §9.3). A failed phase reports `error` instead of the payload: at least one of `events` and `error` is required (contracts/adapter/README.md).
